command.too_big: That container has %s slots, which doesn't fit.
help.clientchest.title: Client chest: /clientchest [<page> | <name>]
help.clientchest.1: The client chest is saved on your computer, so it works on every server and in singleplayer.
help.clientchest.2: Changes save as soon as you make them. The page limit setting can make it unlimited.
help.clientchest.3: Shift-click the arrows to jump to the nearest page with items or a name. Page Up and Page Down also turn pages.
help.clientchest.4: Rename a page to open it by name. All pages lists, searches and deletes pages.
help.clientchest.5: Copy mode takes copies out and leaves the originals in place.
help.clientchest.6: /clientchest import and export copy a page into the held or targeted container, or back.
